purpose: Decide whether the integrated BASE-TFR-HRM-010 approval bridge already closes the non-UI PLAT-003 support slice without cloning the approval engine or inventing a test-only substitute.

auditBasis.independentReview: The first test-only candidate was rejected because population and field-policy authority are not callback-proof claims, an existing direct V2 test was omitted, and the proposed cross-package wrapper could not exercise the actual package-private owner adapter.
auditBasis.pinMeaning: Observation only. Final no-code closure remains withheld until the final clean pushed dwp-dev pins are recorded and the relevant HRM paths are confirmed unchanged.

decision.reason: Existing V2 contract, owner adapter, Approval quorum and zero-skipped PostgreSQL evidence cover PLAT-003. The rejected candidate attempted to turn owner population and field-policy evidence into new callback claims, which would change the contract rather than prove it.

approvalBridgeBoundary: The service-to-service proof binds issuer, audience, caller subject, binding id, purpose, method, exact path, tenant and request-body hash.
Create authority pins requester person, workflow version and form version before the Approval request is accepted.
The terminal callback binds the frozen decision, policy revision, original correlation and payload digest; the owner returns a command receipt bound to correlation and command digest.
CommandReceiptV1 does not carry requesterRef or workflowVersion, so those values are not described as receipt fields.
ownerDataBoundary: Population and field-policy checks belong to the originating public HRM owner PEP and employee-change command, before HR data disclosure or approval submission.
Their accepted digest and revision are frozen in the owner request and copied into immutable owner audit/receipt state.
They are not HrisWorkloadProofV2 callback claims and must not be re-evaluated by a synthetic wrapper test or silently added to PLAT-003.
A future requirement for current-authority re-evaluation at callback time is a separate production contract change and requires a new exact control authority.

duplicatePrevention.hrm010: BASE-TFR-HRM-010 is the integrated overlap implementation and must not be copied, renamed, cherry-picked or reimplemented as HRM-001.
duplicatePrevention.approvalOwnership: dwp-approval-server remains the sole shared approval engine. HRM retains only its request binding and immutable owner-side decision receipt.
duplicatePrevention.redundantWrapperTestForbidden: Do not add an HRM001-named wrapper that merely repeats HrisApprovalBridgeV2Test or cannot call the actual package-private owner adapter.

matrix.finding: The People owner stores the shared V2 request binding and immutable callback receipt while Approval owns workflow execution.

Requester identity, workflow and form versions are pinned in create authority; subject revision and payload are frozen in the request binding; correlation and command digest are bound to the callback receipt.
Approval enforces exact workflow/tenant/role/party delegation plus maker-checker and requester/subject no-self rules; the owner rejects a no-self or stale callback atomically.
An exact callback replays its durable byte-identical outcome while changed input, a stale target or split ownership is rejected without partial effects.

Tenant, purpose, method, exact resource path, caller and request body are fail-closed PLAT-003 workload-proof claims. Population and field-policy are enforced at the originating public owner PEP before disclosure and are not callback-proof claims; re-evaluating them inside PLAT-003 is explicitly not applicable to this non-UI support slice.

The contract module directly tests HrisApprovalBridgeV2, and the integrated People/Approval adapters were executed in the HRM-010 targeted run with 59/59 tests, zero skipped and three PostgreSQL suites.
